summary: Frontend regression test after Home.jsx refactor + 2 new Realm Heist trophies (awakening/furnace). All 21 required Home testids render, no console errors. Deal flow with ZIP 10001 shuffles then reveals restaurant-grid with 6 cards + sort-select working. Mode switching (food->drinks->bars) works and double-tap-active shows any-mode-banner. Group mode toggle shows/hides group-picker. Steampunk collectibles: ff:golem-wake dispatch produces 2 golem-duet-flicker spans on the left golem's eyes during ~10s awakening on right golem (green head glow visible), then localStorage.ff_heists_seen gains 'awakening' + a 'Heist witnessed!' toast appears. ff:furnace-blast then records 'furnace' after ~5s. /rituals page shows trophy-awakening + trophy-furnace unlocked, trophy-count '2 / 25', heist-card-awakening 'The Awakening / STEAMPUNK' and heist-card-furnace 'Furnace Blast / STEAMPUNK' with full descriptions. /journal, /bingo, /leaderboard, /shop all HTTP 200 and render content. No crashes, no console errors detected during any flow.

issues: fate-of-day-card was not present in the DOM after Deal reveal on desktop steampunk viewport — likely gated by conditions (time-of-day / feature flag / result count). Not verified as broken but flagged since the spec listed it as expected.

action_items: Investigate whether fate-of-day-card should always appear after a successful Deal on ZIP 10001 (curated data) — during this run only restaurant-grid + sort-select + 6 cards appeared; fate-of-day-card / fate-of-day-deal were not found. May be intentional gating (already shown today?) but confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: AmbianceScene.jsx is 1025 lines — approaching the 700-line soft ceiling. Consider splitting golem/scene-specific sub-blocks (useGolemWake, useFurnaceBlast, golem render tree) into separate modules for maintainability now that heist wiring lives here.
Home.jsx still 1157 lines post-refactor — good progress from 1564; further extract doSearch/runShuffle into a useShuffle hook to drop under 700.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage seeding only: ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1, ff_theme=dark|steam, ff_muted=1, and ff_heists_seen={awakening,furnace} for rituals verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Intro wizard still appears even when ff_theme_chosen/ff_theme_hint_seen are set — must click 'Skip intro' text button after reload. Golem events are desktop-only (>=640px). golem-duet-flicker uses data-testid (not class); querying '[data-testid="golem-duet-flicker"]' returns 2 spans throughout the ~10s awakening. Awakening records at ~9.9s, furnace at ~5.2s. All Home testids present and integration-clean post-refactor.
rca of the issue: n/a — no blocking issue found. Only open question is intended visibility of fate-of-day-card.
